name: NOAA NCEI
summary: Read daily-summary weather CSV files from NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information, one partition per day, hashed and listed in a manifest.
notes: Used by examples/noaa-daily.workflow.json through the builtin acquire@1, then hash@1 and manifest@1. It needs no key and no model access. Check the terms of each NCEI dataset before redistributing it.
